acceptanceCriteria: Reading projectDir or layout.projectDirectory in a build script no longer marks the layout mapped; only an assignment that remaps a project directory does.
A fixture with rootProject.projectDir reads yields a runnable :module:testDebugUnitTest (or test) task; a fixture with a real remapping keeps the unresolved frontier.
The owning KAT-V0 requirement is traced to the new tests.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). internal/liveverify/affected/kotlin/kotlin.go:180 sets layout.projectMapped when the build text merely contains "projectDir" (for example rootProject.projectDir or layout.projectDirectory), and testTarget then returns task "unknown". On beamfall-android (app-mobile/build.gradle.kts:239,380) and beamfall-android-ui (build.gradle.kts:20, kit/build.gradle.kts:158,355) every unit becomes kotlin:jvm:<module>:unknown:... with build-target-unresolved and test-address-unresolved frontiers, so no Gradle test address is runnable. Expected: only an actual project-directory remapping (projectDir = ... / project(...).projectDir = ... assignment in settings) marks the layout mapped.
title: affected/kotlin: projectMapped substring test on "projectDir" turns every Gradle test task into "unknown" in ordinary Android builds
